title: hydrangea strigosa var. macrophylla
intro: Hydrangea strigosa var. macrophylla, commonly known as the 'Big Leaf Hydrangea', is a species of flowering plant in the family Hydrangiaceae. This plant is known for its large leaves and beautiful flowers, which are often used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Hydrangea strigosa var. macrophylla include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce swelling, relieve pain, and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and immunomodulatory effects.
